summary: Saber's CEO denies replacing human writers with ChatGPT for the Rideshare Stimulator game, despite a former lead writer's claims that she was replaced by the AI tool midway through development. title: Another OpenAI executive takes off
content:

"I believe there are a few important new things the world will need to get right as we enter this next period. I … am excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point." He added that he'd still be around for the next few weeks.
